full_name: Jonathan D. S. Schroeder | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Rhode Island School of Design
bio: The historian and critic Jonathan D. S. Schroeder seeks to create new paths through the histories of race, ethnicity, and migration. At Radcliffe, he will write a full-fledged biography of Harriet and John Jacobs that, in spanning three centuries, four continents, and 11 generations, aims to make the Jacobses a touchstone for understanding the American nation as the product of two experiments at once: one in democracy, the other in tyranny.
